posts.caption:
Four things from a loud week in music 🏆

@dontoliver got a Best New Artist nod at Monday's Grammy nominations, and GTA VI finally landed Thursday. Panchiko brought billy woods back for Day One, and 2 Chainz locked in Dec 4 for his album with Statik Selektah.

What was your favorite music moment this week?
